title: SANITARY MEASURES : VACCINATION CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL = MESURES SANITAIRES : CERTIFICATS DE VACCINATION EXIGÉS DANS LES VOYAGES INTERNATIONAUX

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: A bilingual amendment to the 1966 vaccination certificate requirements for international travel, updating cholera notes for Australia, adding cholera and yellow fever age exemptions for Brunei, and recording Italy's cholera certificate requirement for arrivals from India with a note questioning its conformity with the Regulations.

sections.extract: - 517 - MESURES SANITAIRES — SANITARY MEASURES CERTIFICATS DE VACCINATION EXIGÉS DANS LES VOYAGES INTERNATIONAUX VACCINATION CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL Amendements à la publication de 1966 Amendments to 1966 publication Australie Dans la note concernant le choléra, insérer: de l’Irak. Australia In the note concerning choiera, insert: Iraq. Brunéi Supprimer la note et insérer: Choléra et fièvre
